headline: Eterna Reports 635% Surge in Nine-Month Pre-Tax Profit
summary: Eterna Plc reported a consolidated pre-tax profit of N10.28 billion for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, marking a 635.80% increase from N1.40 billion in the same period of 2025.
why: Eterna Plc is a Nigerian energy company engaged in the marketing and distribution of petroleum products. Corporate earnings reports provide key fundamental data for institutional equity investors.
